Fibonacci Sequence Swing [ChartPrime] ⯁ OVERVIEW Fibonacci Sequence Swing is a structural swing-based Fibonacci tool that goes beyond classic retracement ratios. Instead of fixed percentages, it uses the Fibonacci number sequence itself to divide each completed or forming swing and evaluates how price actually interacts with every level in real time.

The result is a dynamic map of structurally important Fibonacci levels , ranked by real market interaction rather than theory.
